# AstroGate Protocol — Full AI & Auditor Specification (`llms-full.txt`)

> Decentralized Fair-Flywheel v4.5 Token Launchpad, Soroswap AMM Studio, Sorobits (SEP-50) 100% On-Chain Genomic NFTs, Read-Only REST API, MCP Server & Telegram Mini App on Stellar / Soroban.

- **Repository**: `https://github.com/NunaLabsDev/astrogate`
- **Live Web / Mini App (Testnet)**: `https://astrogate.pages.dev`
- **Developer & Audit Hub**: `https://astrogate.pages.dev/docs`
- **Compact Index**: `https://astrogate.pages.dev/llms.txt`
- **OpenAPI 3.1 Spec**: `https://astrogate.pages.dev/openapi.json`
- **Remote MCP Endpoint**: `POST https://astrogate.pages.dev/mcp` (JSON-RPC 2.0)
- **License**: MIT source code ([LICENSE](https://github.com/NunaLabsDev/astrogate/blob/main/LICENSE)) · Brand/Logos protected ([TRADEMARK.md](https://github.com/NunaLabsDev/astrogate/blob/main/TRADEMARK.md))

## 2. Fair-Flywheel v4.5 Constants & Math Parity

Source of truth: `contracts/launchpad/src/contract.rs` and `frontend/src/lib/curve-math.ts`.

- **Precision**: `7` decimals (`1 XLM = 10_000_000` stroops).
- **Fixed Supply**: `10,000,000` tokens (`100_000_000_000_000` base units), hard-capped via OpenZeppelin `Capped`, ownership renounced atomically on `launch_fair`.
- **Creation Fee & Initial Creator Seed**: `7 XLM` flat protocol fee (`70_000_000` stroops) + `>= 2 XLM` initial creator curve buy (`creator_seed_locked` unlocked upon graduation, `7 days` stalled rescue, or `30 days` closed principal return).
- **Token Partition (10,000 bps)**:
  - **66.0% (`6,600,000`)** Virtual Bonding Curve (`1,000 vXLM` start -> `1,000 real XLM` graduation target, `13,200,000` virtual token start; `4.00x` curve range).
  - **33.0% (`3,300,000`)** Soroswap DEX Pool Reserve seeded at graduation alongside `>= 1,000 XLM` (`0%` price cliff), with **100% of minted LP time-locked inside the Launchpad contract for 7 years (`reclaim_expired_lp` thereafter)**.
  - **0.3% (`30,000`)** Post-graduation creator vesting (`5` tranches of `6,000` every `3 days` = `15 days` total via `claim_creator_vesting`).
  - **0.40% (`40,000`)** 3-Checkpoint Jackpot Ladder (`+5,000` Spark at `250 XLM` and `+10,000` King Crown at `500 XLM` escrowed in-contract until graduation and claimed via `claim_jackpot`; `+25,000` Graduation Jackpot awarded at `1,000 XLM`).
  - **0.30% (`30,000`)** Developer / Protocol Ecosystem allocation transferred to `treasury` atomically upon graduation.
- **3-Stage Bonding Curve Fees**:
  - **Stage 1 (`< 250 XLM`, 0–25%)**: Buy `30 bps` (`0.30%` = `20 bps` treasury + `10 bps` floor), Sell `120 bps` (`1.20%` = `30 bps` treasury + `90 bps` floor).
  - **Stage 2 (`250–500 XLM`, 25–50%)**: Buy `50 bps` (`0.50%` = `30 bps` treasury + `20 bps` floor), Sell `180 bps` (`1.80%` = `40 bps` treasury + `140 bps` floor).
  - **Stage 3 (`500–1,000 XLM`, 50–100%)**: Buy `25 bps` (`0.25%` = `15 bps` treasury + `10 bps` floor), Sell `150 bps` (`1.50%` = `30 bps` treasury + `120 bps` floor).
- **Organic Deflation & Anti-MEV DEX Buyback (`trigger_buyback_burn` / `trigger_buyback_burn_with_bounty`)**:
  - Permissionless swap of accumulated `buyback_xlm_reserve` on Soroswap followed by `token.burn()`.
  - Capped at `min(25 bps of pool XLM reserve, 0.8000000 XLM)` per call with a `300s` per-token cooldown (`BuybackLastTs`) and optional `2%` XLM keeper gas rebate (`<= 0.05 XLM`).
- **Burn-to-Chat (`burn_shout`)**:
  - `>= 50` tokens: Chat Shout; `>= 500` tokens: Hype Shout; `>= 5,000` tokens: King Shout (24h decay). Executes real `token.burn_from()`, up to `15` shouts stored per token (`1..=160` bytes).

## 3. Smart Contract Entrypoints (`contracts/`)

### `contracts/launchpad/src/contract.rs` (`astro-launchpad-contract`)
- **Launch & Trading**: `launch_fair(params: FairLaunchParams)`, `launch_token(params: LaunchParams)`, `quote_buy(token, xlm_in)`, `quote_sell(token, token_amount)`, `buy_curve(...)`, `sell_curve(...)`.
- **Flywheel, Escrow & Graduation**: `reclaim_expired_lp(token)`, `trigger_buyback_burn(token)`, `trigger_buyback_burn_with_bounty(caller, token)`, `claim_jackpot(user, token)`, `get_pending_jackpot(token, user)`, `is_curve_closed(token)`, `sweep_empty_curve_fees(token)`, `refund_stalled_launch(creator, token)`, `claim_creator_vesting(caller, token)`.
- **Engagement & Reads**: `burn_shout(sender, token, amount, message)`, `get_launches(offset, limit)`, `get_market_page(offset, limit)`, `get_launch(token)`, `get_curve(token)`, `get_pilot(user)`, `get_launch_count()`, `get_shouts(token)`, `get_king_shout(token)`, `get_creation_fee()`.
- **TTL & Governance (48h Timelock)**: `extend_ttl()`, `extend_launch_ttl(token)`, `set_paused(paused)` (pauses new launches only — sells/exits/claims remain open), `set_treasury(new_treasury)`, `set_token_wasm_hash(hash)`, `transfer_admin(new_admin)`, `accept_admin()`, `propose_upgrade(new_wasm_hash)`, `execute_upgrade()`, `cancel_upgrade()`, `get_pending_upgrade()`.

### `contracts/token/src/contract.rs` (`astro-token`)
- OpenZeppelin Stellar SEP-41 (`Capped`, `TotalSupply`, `FungibleBurnable`, `Ownable`).
- Curve Transfer Lock: `lock_until_graduated(launchpad)`, `unlock_transfers()`, `is_transfers_unlocked()`, `extend_ttl()`, `mint(to, amount)`.
- While curve-locked (`!unlocked`), `transfer` and `transfer_from` reject P2P movements (only the Launchpad gate can move curve tokens), while `burn` and `burn_from` stay enabled for `burn_shout`.

### `contracts/sorobits/src/contract.rs` (`astro-sorobits-contract`)
- SEP-50 NFTs with 100% on-chain `32x32` RLE-compressed pixel SVG (`<= 720` runs, `<= 12,800` SVG bytes), two-ledger commit-reveal RNG (`M-01`), `TokenBaseXp` anti-XP-laundering, dynamic Season 2+ layer/palette counts, and 48-hour upgrade timelock (`C-04`).
- Entrypoints: `claim_pioneer(user)`, `claim_quest_badge(user, archetype_id)`, `commit_capsule(user, commitment)`, `reveal_capsule(user, user_entropy)`, `commit_forge(owner, burn_id_a, burn_id_b, commitment)`, `reveal_forge(owner, user_entropy)`, `mint_capsule(user, user_entropy)`, `get_capsule_quota(user)`, `get_capsule_fee()`, `sync_epigenetics(token_id)`, `forge_ascend(owner, burn_id_a, burn_id_b, user_entropy)`, `has_claimed(user, archetype_id)`, `set_launchpad(launchpad)`, `get_launchpad()`, `set_xlm_sac(xlm_sac)`, `get_xlm_sac()`, `mint_genesis(...)`, `mint_generative(...)`, `update_epigenetics(...)`, `register_layer(...)`, `register_palette(...)`, `set_active_season(season)`, `seal_season(caller, season)`, `render_svg(token_id)`, `animated_svg(token_id)`, `raw_bitmap(token_id)`, `get_sorobit(token_id)`, `tokens_of(owner)`, `tokens_of_page(owner, offset, limit)`, `genesis_minted(archetype_id)`, `is_season_sealed(season)`, `extend_ttl()`, `extend_token_ttl(token_id)`, `propose_upgrade(new_wasm_hash)`, `execute_upgrade()`, `cancel_upgrade()`, `get_pending_upgrade()`.

---

## 4. Security Invariants for Auditors

1. **Escrowed Checkpoints & Pre-Grad Pool Griefing Defense (`C-01`)**: Spark (`+5K`) and Crown (`+10K`) jackpots accrue in Launchpad escrow until graduation (`claim_jackpot`), defeating flash-buy siphon loops; `seed_soroswap_and_burn_lp` checks `pair.total_supply() > 0 || (r0 > 0 && r1 > 0)` instead of raw `r0 > 0 || r1 > 0`, tolerating unilateral XLM dust sent to a pair while rejecting pre-seeded LP pools.
2. **CEI, Reentrancy Guard, 30d Curve Closeout & 48h Upgrade Timelock (`C-02`, `C-04`)**: `execute_curve_buy` persists `CurveState` before external transfers and holds a temporary `ReentrancyLock`; 30-day closed curves (`CurveClosed`) return contributor principal before fee dust sweep; both `launchpad` and `sorobits` enforce a 48h upgrade timelock.
3. **1:1 Curve Parity & Anti-MEV Buybacks (`H-01`)**: `contracts/launchpad/src/contract.rs` and `frontend/src/lib/curve-math.ts` share identical integer math (floor/ceil rounding, fee bps, graduation cap); buyback-and-burn swaps cap chunks at `min(0.25% pool, 0.8000000 XLM)` per call with a `300s` cooldown and `2%` keeper XLM rebate (`<= 0.05 XLM`).
4. **Client Native Wallet Crypto & Biometrics (`frontend/src/lib/hot-wallet/`, `wallet-directory.ts`)**: `PBKDF2-SHA256` (`210,000` iterations) + `AES-GCM-256` with `meta.publicKey` bound as GCM `additionalData` (AAD), optional `Telegram.WebApp.BiometricManager` / WebAuthn PRF quick-unlock, transient key buffer zeroing, recovered publicKey verification, `15m` idle auto-lock (`HOT_IDLE_AUTO_LOCK_MS`), multi-wallet `Primary` routing for `@username`, `AGVAULT1:` portable encrypted sync, and Ed25519 ownership proofs.
5. **Stellar Minimum Reserve & Signing Safety**: `frontend/src/lib/xlm.ts` queries Horizon `subentry_count`, `num_sponsoring`, `num_sponsored`, and `selling_liabilities` before allowing signatures; destructive UI actions require inline 2-step confirmation and synchronous double-submit locks.
6. **Cloudflare Pages Functions & Worker Security (`C-03`, `frontend/functions/`, `frontend/worker/`)**: All public dynamic routes (`/telegram/webhook`, `/api/*`, `/mcp`, `/openapi.json`, `/health`, `/.well-known/stellar.toml`) run under `https://astrogate.pages.dev` via internal `ASTROW` Service Binding to `astrogate-stellar` (`workers_dev: false`, `sw.js` bypasses dynamic/metadata routes). Constant-time SHA-256 verification of `X-Telegram-Bot-Api-Secret-Token`, strict CORS (`walletCorsHeaders` on wallet link/vault + origin allowlist on pulse), HMAC-SHA256 `verifyTelegramInitData` (`401` on unverified `tgUserId > 0`, `403` against unverified `@username` overwrites), sliding-window IP rate limits (`15/min` wallet link, `10/min` logo upload), single-claim pulse tx deduplication, MCP batch cap (`<= 10`), secret regex detection across tokens, and `community: false` feed-only routing (`@AstroGateFeed` only).

---

## 5. Public REST API & MCP Integration

- **REST Endpoints**:
  - `GET /api/v1/health`: Network config, live contracts, Fair-Flywheel v4.5 parameters, Sorobits limits.
  - `GET /api/v1/tokens`: Active bonding curves and graduated Soroswap pairs with XLM reserves.
  - `GET /api/v1/tokens/:id`: Full token metadata, `CurveState`, `kingShout`, and `recentShouts`.
  - `GET /api/v1/tokens/:id/audit`: Automated on-chain verification (`ownership_renounced`, `launchpad_verified`, `curve_or_lp_lock`, `lpProtection`, `proof_of_burn_vault`).
  - `GET /api/v1/tokens/:id/quote?amountIn=<stroops>&direction=buy|sell&slippage=2`: Deterministic quote.
  - `GET /api/v1/sorobits`: Supply, genesis archetype counts, RLE render budgets.
  - `POST /api/telegram/session`: Verifies Telegram Mini App `initData` HMAC-SHA256 signature (`24h` TTL) before mounting the lazy-loaded Mini App; external browsers receive a presentation landing page redirecting to `@AstroGateSorobanBot`.
  - `GET /api/v1/wallet/resolve?q=@username`: Resolve `@username`, numeric user ID, or `G...` address to linked primary wallet (`no-store`).
  - `POST /api/v1/wallet/link`: Bind `@username` / `initData` (`24h` TTL) to Stellar wallet(s) via Ed25519 signature (`±300s`, anti-replay nonces).
  - `GET /api/v1/wallet/vault`: Fetch authenticated Telegram Mini App user's `AGVAULT1:` encrypted bundle (`X-Telegram-Init-Data` required, `24h` TTL).
  - `GET /openapi.json`: OpenAPI 3.1.0 schema.
- **MCP Server (`POST /mcp` or `cd frontend && npm run mcp`)**:
  - Tools: `get_protocol_info`, `get_market_tokens`, `get_token_details`, `verify_anti_rug`, `quote_swap`, `get_sorobits_info`, `resolve_wallet`.
  - Resources: `astrogate://protocol/overview`, `astrogate://market/snapshot`.

---

## 6. Reproducible Build, Test & Audit Commands

```bash
# Smart Contracts (Rust / Soroban)
stellar contract build --package astro-token
cargo fmt --all -- --check
cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings
cargo test --workspace
stellar contract build

# Frontend & Cloudflare Worker
cd frontend
npm ci
npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.worker.json
npm run check

# Live Testnet Read-Only / Friendbot E2E Verification (no secrets required)
npm run verify:discovery
npm run verify:token-events
npm run verify:demo
```
